description: Defines the ProjectRelease class which models a Drupal project release, including validation, properties, and methods for release data.

classes.name: ProjectRelease
classes.description: A value object representing a Drupal project release, with properties for version, date, URLs, release types, and methods for validation and property access.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a ProjectRelease instance from an array of release data, validating the data first.

methods.name: validateReleaseData
methods.description: Validates the release data array against constraints, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the release date as a Unix timestamp or null.

methods.name: isSecurityRelease
methods.description: Checks if the release is a security update.

methods.name: isUnsupported
methods.description: Checks if the release is unsupported.

methods.name: isInsecure
methods.description: Checks if the release is insecure.

methods.name: isReleaseType
methods.description: Helper method to check if the release matches a specific type.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Checks if the release is published.

methods.name: isCoreCompatible
methods.description: Returns whether the release is compatible with Drupal core.
